name: joy2know-polish-team
description: A four-editor polishing team that takes what you already have — a finished draft, a long report, a spreadsheet — and hands back something you can actually send. It diagnoses the material first, then routes it: untangle the structure, cut a long report into talkable pages, turn a spreadsheet into a one-page interactive dashboard, and strip the machine tone out of the final wording. Every edit is traceable to a named rule, and a gate script blocks anything that changes meaning, numbers or structure.

displayDescription.en: The draft is ready — only delivery is left. Four editors each own one leg: untangle, distill into talkable pages, build a one-page dashboard, and strip machine tone last. A diagnosis decides who steps in, not all four.
displayDescription.zh: 稿子写完了只差交付：理清条理、压成能讲的、做成能发的看板，最后改掉机器腔调。上哪几棒由体检决定，不是全上。
